blockchain.excerpt: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

blockchain.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel

blockchain.title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks

blockchain.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
